item.description:
SKEGNESS COACH TRIP - SOLD OUT!

Sunday 7th June 2026

Back by popular demand! Our bi-annual day trip to Skegness for our members, friends and families.

Tickets were available on a first-come, first-served basis and are very reasonably priced at just £15. Renal patients will get refunded on the day.

Sunday 7th June

Coach departs Leicester General Hospital @8AM

Coach return leaves Skegness @5PM
